title: Palindrome Pairs
description: Find all unique pairs of distinct indices [i, j] in the given list of words such that the concatenation of words[i] + words[j] is a palindrome.

steps.note: Initialize map for quick lookup: {abcd: 0, dcba: 1}
Prefix '' is palindrome, look for reverse of suffix 'abcd' -> 'dcba'
Split 'dcba' into prefix 'dcba' and suffix '', check suffixes
Suffix '' is palindrome. Look for reverse of 'dcba' -> 'abcd'
Found 'abcd' at index 0. Add pair [1, 0] is invalid, look for [i, target] -> [1, 0]
